### 1. Firefox on Chromebook / ChromeOS
- **Can it be installed?** Yes. Mozilla officially supports running desktop Firefox on ChromeOS devices that meet requirements.
- **System Requirements:** An x86-based Chromebook running ChromeOS 80 or later with Linux (Beta/Crostini) support enabled (Debian 10 Buster or newer).
- **Official Install Methods:**
  1. **Mozilla DEB package via APT repository (Recommended):**
     - Set up the APT keyrings directory: `sudo install -d -m 0755 /etc/apt/keyrings`
     - Import the Mozilla signing key: `wget -q https://packages.mozilla.org/apt/repo-signing-key.gpg -O- | sudo tee /etc/apt/keyrings/packages.mozilla.org.asc > /dev/null`
     - Add Mozilla’s APT repository to sources (`/etc/apt/sources.list.d/mozilla.list` or `mozilla.sources`) and set pin priority in `/etc/apt/preferences.d/mozilla`.
     - Run `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install firefox`.
  2. **Flatpak via Flathub:** Install Flatpak on ChromeOS Linux, then install via `flatpak install flathub org.mozilla.firefox`.
- **Page left open:** Tab ID 2052873292 (`https://support.mozilla.org/en-US/kb/run-firefox-chromeos`).

### 2. Apple iCloud Passwords Extension
- **Extension Name:** iCloud Passwords
- **Publisher:** Apple
- **Listing URL:** `https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/icloud-passwords/pejdijmoenmkgeppbflobdenhhabjlaj?hl=en`
- **Purpose:** Enables users to autofill saved passwords from their Apple iCloud Keychain when browsing in Chrome, and saves new passwords created in Chrome directly back to iCloud Keychain so they remain synchronized across Apple devices.
- **Page left open:** Tab ID 2052873295 *(Note: Chrome's native security policy restricts extension scripting/debugging on `chromewebstore.google.com` pages, but the tab is open at the official store listing).*

### 3. Google Docs Images Showing Exclamation Marks / Refusing to Load
Based on verified troubleshooting recommendations from Google Docs Help and Diamond Product Experts:
- **Interfering Browser Extensions:** Extensions (particularly ad blockers, privacy blockers, or web shields) often intercept or block requests to Google user-content CDN domains (`lh*.googleusercontent.com`) where Docs images reside.
  - *Fix:* Open the document in an Incognito window. If images display properly, disable all browser extensions, clear browser cache/cookies, restart the device, and re-enable extensions one-by-one to identify the conflicting one.
- **Document Size & Image Limits:** While Google Drive can store files larger than 50 MB, Google Docs cannot open files exceeding 50 MB. High-resolution uncompressed images frequently push the document over this limit, causing images to fail loading and display warning triangles/exclamation marks.
  - *Fix:* Compress large images before inserting, or replace existing oversized images with compressed versions.
- **Network / Firewall Restrictions:** School, corporate, or VPN network filters may block Google's image content delivery hostnames.
- **Hardware Acceleration:** Toggle "Use graphics acceleration when available" in Chrome settings (`chrome://settings/system`) and restart Chrome.

- **Page left open:** Tab ID 2052873296.

### 5. Patreon Homepage
- **Behavior:** Behaved normally.
- **Verification:** Navigated to `https://www.patreon.com/`. Standard browsing and full navigation elements loaded without errors, including links for "Creators", "Features", "Pricing", "Resources", "Find a Creator", "Log in", and "Get Started".
- **Page left open:** Tab ID 2052873297.

### 6. YouTube ("YouTube Rewind 2011") Playback
- **Behavior:** Behaved normally; video stream and media player controls functioned without issue.
- **First Moments Observation:** In the opening moments (around 1–2 seconds), host Rebecca Black appears standing in the center of a stage in front of a giant wall screen displaying the red and white "YouTube" logo across a tile grid. She wears a white jacket over a dark top and black pants. As playback continues, the camera zooms into a close-up of Rebecca speaking with a blurred red-and-white checkered backdrop.
- **Page left open:** Tab ID 2052873298 (`https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PaerCEvQdes`).
